about: A-202.1 C4 boundary controls for types 29-31 with the outer session fenced (Astra's RC2-FIXES-C review 01, edge probes 01 and 02; the coordinator's C4 Identifier boundary ruling, 2026-10-26). The Identifier grammar of the fixed-literal string slots stays at C4 and only the equality follows the fence: an empty, C0 or DEL value is EVENT_DATA_INVALID, a value over 256 UTF-8 bytes is INVALID_INPUT (spec02 section 2.2 step 7, the engine-wide limit rule; these are its first shared vectors), a well-formed wrong value is SESSION_FENCED. The hash-boundary group: original and trailing-LF hash controls.
